The garage floor was under about 20cm of water and it ruined a chest freezer and a bunch of boxes we had stored on the floor. We think it'll cost around $2,500 to replace the freezer and the stuff that got wet.

**Flood definition (AAMI Contents PDS):**

Flood is defined as "the covering of normally dry land by water that has escaped or been released from the normal confines of: • any lake, river, creek, or other natural watercourse (whether or not altered or modified) • any reservoir, canal, or dam" [AAMI Contents PDS, page 100].

**Coverage implications:**

Based on the excerpt regarding liability for falling/moving objects, the policy explicitly states: "We don't cover loss or damage caused by flood or storm surge" [AAMI Contents PDS, page 49]. This exclusion appears in the context of a specific insured event (objects being carried by water, falling trees, etc.), so water from a creek or river overflowing its normal confines — meeting the definition of "Flood" above — would fall under this exclusion in that section.

**Limitation of available information:**

The excerpts provided do not include the general "Flood" section of the PDS or any specific insured event listing that may separately address flood cover elsewhere in the policy (e.g., an optional flood cover section). The excerpts also do not show whether flood cover can be added, included by default, or opted into under this AAMI Contents policy.
